item.research_question: What are the synthesis strategies and applications of nanoscale high-entropy alloys?
item.material_system: Nanoscale high-entropy alloys (HEAs) with various compositions
item.processing_route: Thermodynamic non-equilibrium processes, including mechanical alloying, laser melting, arc discharge, and wet chemical synthesis
item.mechanism: The high-entropy effect, lattice distortion effect, sluggish diffusion effect, and cocktail effect contribute to the unique properties of HEAs
item.limitations: The synthesis of nanoscale HEAs poses significant challenges, including the selection of constituent elements and the formation of stable single-phase solid solutions
item.future_work: Further research is needed to develop innovative methods for producing HEAs with unique properties and to explore their applications in various fields
quotes: High-entropy alloys (HEAs) display a broader spectrum of unique properties
The high-entropy effect effectively explains why the phase number of HEAs is much less than that predicted by theoretical equations
The sluggish diffusion process endows HEAs with enhanced phase stability
